issues: 点阵在 480×270 设计坐标里经 transform 放大，第二道波的光晕被栅格化成成片的方块光雾
第二道波在 pulse2>0.3 处硬切颜色和光晕，每个点亮/灭都是开关式跳变
未点亮的点 scale 为 0，开场几乎全黑，交代不出阵列规模
纯色 #0a0b10 底、扁平圆片，没有空间与受光
末帧中心点仍在高亮脉冲中，没有落定
changes: 改为 1920×1080 原生 SVG 作画、正方格距 100px（波前成正圆），光晕用径向渐变按目标分辨率光栅化
第二道波颜色与 2.3R 青色光晕按 pulse2 连续插值；第一道波前按 sin(w1π) 提亮并带淡蓝辉光，读得出“亮边推过去”
每格先有一枚暗“插座”（r=4，16%），通电时点从插座里鼓出；圆点加左上受光的球面明暗
暗场柔光底 + 中心能量辉光（随起手爆发与汇聚两次起落）+ 暗角 + 颗粒
第二道波压到 0.57+(1−d)·0.18、窗 0.12，汇到中心时放一圈外扩淡出的回执细环，尾段约 15f 完全静止
issuesEn: The grid was drawn in 480×270 design units and transform-upscaled, so the second wave's glow rasterized into blocky square haze
The second wave hard-switched color and glow at pulse2>0.3, so every dot popped on/off
Unlit dots had scale 0, so the opening was nearly black and the grid's size was never established
Flat #0a0b10 background and flat discs, no space or lighting
The center dot was still mid-pulse on the last frame; no settle
changesEn: Redrawn as native 1920×1080 SVG on a square 100px pitch (circular wavefront); glows are radial gradients rasterized at output resolution
Second-wave color and a 2.3R cyan glow interpolate continuously with pulse2; the first wavefront brightens by sin(w1π) with a faint blue halo so a bright edge visibly sweeps out
Every cell starts as a dim 'socket' (r=4, 16%) that the lit dot swells out of; dots get top-left spherical shading
Dark soft-lit backdrop, a center energy glow that rises with the initial burst and again on convergence, vignette and grain
Second wave tightened to 0.57+(1−d)·0.18 with a 0.12 window; on reaching the center it emits one expanding receipt ring, then ~15f of full stillness
